definitions.full: H5654. Obed Edom עֹבֵדאֱדֹם , and ( 2Chr 25:24 ) אֱדוֺם׳ע proper name, masculine ( servant of (god) Edom , compare אדם עבד CIS No. 295 ; Dr Sm 206, 298 and references , RS Sem i. 43; 2nd ed. 42 and references , HPS 2Sam 6:10 ; but Bae Rel 10 servant of man , אֱדֹם = אָדָם , which is thought possible by Nö ZMG xlii (1888), 470 Buhl Edomiter 49 ); — 1 the Gittite who harboured the ark 2Sam 6:10-11 , (twice in verse); 6:12 (twice in verse) = 1Chr 13:13-14 , (twice in verse), 15:25 ; ᵐ5 Αβεδδαρα , ᵐ5 L Αβεδδαδαν . 2 (= 1 ?) one of the chief Levitical singers and doorkeepers 1Chr 15:18 , 21 , 24 ; 16:5 , 38 (twice in verse); 26:4 , 8 (twice in verse); 26:15 ; ᵐ5 Αβαεδωμ , Αβδεδωμ , etc., ᵐ5 L Αβεδδομ . 3 the family of the same 2Chr 25:24 (not in || 2Kin 14:14 ).
